app.name: Kaizer Games
timer.label: Time left
settings.title: Settings
settings.progressNote: Progress stays on this device. To move it to another device, save it to a file and load it there.
settings.resetConfirm: This removes your pet, settings and all progress from this device. A saved progress file is not affected.
progress.loadError: That file could not be read. Choose a file saved from Kaizer Games.
picker.title: Choose your pet
picker.intro: Your pet keeps you company while you play. You can change it later in Settings.
home.emptySlot: Empty spot for a future item
sound.offerText: Each correct star plays a soft note. You can change this any time in Settings.
cz.noneForFilter: No constellations for these levels yet.
cz.tapInOrder: Tap the stars in the order of the sentence.
cz.dragHint: You can also drag a line through the stars.
cz.notYet: That star doesn't come next. Try another one.
cz.light.title: Ilumina la frase
cz.light.task.capital: Tap a word to give it a capital letter (the first word, and names).
cz.light.task.close: Put the right mark at the end.
cz.light.task.accent: Words with a small accent button may need a written accent.
cz.light.task.comma: Add commas where the sentence needs them.
cz.light.task.open: Questions and exclamations open with ¿ or ¡.
cz.light.trayHelp: Choose a mark, then tap a gap. Choose “remove” to empty a gap.
cz.hint.capital: A sentence starts with a capital letter, and so do names of people and places.
cz.hint.close: Look at the end: is it a statement (.), a question (?) or an exclamation (!)?
cz.hint.open: In Spanish, a question opens with ¿ and an exclamation with ¡.
cz.hint.accent: One of the words with an accent button needs a different form.
cz.hint.comma: Check the commas: this sentence has two parts, or it has one comma too many.
cz.done.title: Constellation lit!
cz.story.intro: Each story is a group of constellations. Clear them in order to see the whole story.
cz.story.title: The whole story
cz.listen.intro: Listen, then tap the stars in the order you heard.
cz.listen.unavailable: This device has no Spanish voice, and there are no recordings for these sentences yet. Try on another device or browser.
cz.memory.intro: Constellations you have lit come back to visit after 1, 3, 7, 21 and 60 days. The ones that twinkle are ready.
cz.memory.none: Nothing to review yet. Light a constellation on the map first.
cz.memory.recall: Now tap the stars from memory.
cz.memory.finished: This one is in long-term memory now.
sol.intro: Put every word card on its category. Tap a card, then tap a category, or drag the card.
sol.expertHelp: The categories have no names: build the groups yourself, then name them.
sol.notHere: “{word}” does not go in “{cat}”. Try another one.
sol.notHereGroup: “{word}” does not belong with these cards. Try another group, or an empty one.
sol.nameHelp: Choose a name for each group.
sol.nameWrong: Some names do not fit yet. Look at the words in each group again.
sol.none: No sets for these levels yet.
